title: X2Streaming-ASR: wait when uncertain, emit when ready for streaming ASR
title_zh: X2Streaming-ASR：不确定时等待，准备好时输出——面向流式 ASR 的自适应提交策略
abstract_en: Streaming automatic speech recognition (ASR) for real-time voice agents and full-duplex dialogue must provide accurate partial transcripts with low commit latency. Existing systems commonly use a fixed chunk size, look-ahead, or target delay, or encourage emissions near estimated acoustic boundaries. These approaches do not directly optimize how much additional context to use at each output position under a single-pass, hard-commit constraint. We propose X2Streaming-ASR, which decomposes streaming recognition into when to commit and what to commit. Its three-stage training procedure first establishes streaming recognition ability, then warm-starts the commit policy with automatically probed trajectories, and finally refines the policy using character-level, segment-assigned group-relative rewards for recognition accuracy and latency. Across AISHELL-1/2/3 and WenetSpeech, X2Streaming-ASR achieves a mean character-level commit latency of 27-84 ms relative to forced-aligned character endpoints, compared with 409-585 ms for the evaluated streaming baselines. It achieves the best streaming CER among the evaluated systems on AISHELL-1 and AISHELL-3 with substantially lower latency.
abstract_zh: 针对实时语音智能体和全双工对话中流式 ASR 需要兼顾准确率与提交延迟的问题，X2Streaming-ASR 将流式识别拆分为“何时提交”和“提交什么”两个决策。该方法采用三阶段训练：首先建立流式识别能力；随后利用自动探测的提交轨迹初始化提交策略；最后通过基于字符、按片段分配的组相对奖励，同时优化识别准确率与延迟。在 AISHELL-1/2/3 和 WenetSpeech 上，X2Streaming-ASR 相对于强制对齐字符端点的平均字符级提交延迟为 27–84 ms，显著低于流式基线的 409–585 ms；同时在 AISHELL-1 和 AISHELL-3 上取得最佳流式 CER。
key_points_zh: 将流式 ASR 分解为“何时提交”与“提交什么”，直接学习单次前向、硬提交约束下的上下文使用量。
提出三阶段训练流程：流式能力预训练、基于自动探测轨迹的提交策略热启动，以及结合字符级准确率和延迟奖励的策略优化。
采用按字符、按片段分配的组相对奖励，使提交策略能够在识别准确率与提交延迟之间进行细粒度权衡。
在 AISHELL-1/2/3 和 WenetSpeech 上实现 27–84 ms 的平均字符级提交延迟，相比基线的 409–585 ms 大幅降低。
在 AISHELL-1 和 AISHELL-3 上取得评测系统中的最佳流式 CER，体现出低延迟与高准确率的兼顾能力。

llm_assessment.comment: The learned hard-commit policy directly addresses partial-transcript latency and stability, a critical bottleneck for responsive full-duplex voice agents.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作通过学习式硬提交策略直接改善部分转写的延迟与稳定性，解决了全双工语音智能体的关键瓶颈。
